thread:
linh_partnerships: quick sync — we need to finalize the Snowflake connector manifest and the Databricks vector-table mapping before the marketplace listing cut. specifically: telemetry fields, billing dimensions, and the join key for vectors. can we align today? @james_eng @sara_pm

james_eng: i can do a pass on the manifest after stand. do we have the final telemetry schema from infra?

mike_infra: sending the trimmed schema now, fyi some fields are optional depending on dedicated vs hosted.

mike_infra: ```json
{
  "telemetry": ["request_id","model_variant","latency_ms","tokens_in","tokens_out","customer_tier"],
  "billing_dimensions": ["tokens","model_name","region"]
}
```

sara_pm: thanks mike — for marketplace we need a stable "billing_dimensions" subset. ops wants tokens + model_name only. product prefers region too. tradeoff?

linh_partnerships: marketplace listing requires region metadata for pricing tiers, so we should keep region. but make customer_tier optional for now.

ana_si: from SI enablement POV we need the vector table mapping documented. different customers use different id schemes. recommend we expose a canonical join_key and an example CTAS script for Databricks/Snowflake.

james_eng: agreed. proposed mapping CSV below (col_order is not important but names must match):

"vector_table_column,description,example"
"id,primary id for join,12345"
"embedding,array of floats,[0.01,0.2,...]"
"updated_at,iso timestamp,2025-02-11T15:04:05Z"
"metadata,json blob,{\"source\":\"kb\"}"

linh_partnerships: can we include a tiny compatibility shim for older vector DBs that use base64 embeddings? maybe a flag in the manifest `embedding_encoding: [\"float_array\",\"base64\"]`.

james_eng: yep we can support both. default to float_array. add `encoding` enum to manifest.

linh_partnerships: cool. action items: 1) james to update connector manifest with telemetry + billing + encoding enum (ETA today EOD) 2) mike to confirm which telemetry fields are gated on Dedicated (ETA tomorrow) 3) sara to draft the marketplace pricing blurb that references region dimension (ETA Thu) 4) ana to write CTAS example scripts for Snowflake + Databricks and include a note about base64 shim.

sara_pm: will start pricing blurb. one more ask: legal wants a short data residency note for the listing (2 lines). can partnerships draft that?

linh_partnerships: i can draft it — will keep it high level: "customers can choose hosting region; data residency follows region selection and contract terms."

ana_si: for SI handoff, please add a `onboarding_steps.md` snippet to the repo with a checklist: terraform creds, test dataset, schema migration script, monitoring policy. i'll add a template.

james_eng: putting a PR up in ~2h to `connectors/manifest.json` with all the fields. PR link will be posted here.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: connector-manifest-update -> staging on 2025-02-12T02:30:00Z :rocket:

mike_infra: noted. i'll validate telemetry ingestion in staging after deploy. ping me with PR link. :thumbsup:

linh_partnerships: awesome — thanks everyone. i'll collect PR + CTAS + pricing blurb and assemble the marketplace package. tagging this thread as the "marketplace manifest sync" in my notes. will follow up with a short checklist when ready. :white_check_mark:
